x = stack.pop() — 1 popped off the end of stack; x = 1

chapters.title: Floyd–Warshall transitive closure

frames.caption: Floyd–Warshall transitive closure — O(V³ + q) time, O(V²) extra space. Input: check_if_prerequisite(n=3, prerequisites=[[1, 2], [1, 0], [2, 0]], queries=[[1, 0], [1, 2]]). Step through to watch the code work on this input.
reach = [[False] * n for _ in range(n)] — reach = [[F, F, F], [F, F, F], [F, F, F]]
return [reach[u][v] for u, v in queries] — returns [T, T]. Result: [T, T]

chapters.title: Topological order with ancestor bitsets

frames.caption: Topological order with ancestor bitsets — O(V · (V + E) / w + q) time, O(V² / w) extra space. Input: check_if_prerequisite(n=3, prerequisites=[[1, 2], [1, 0], [2, 0]], queries=[[1, 0], [1, 2]]). Step through to watch the code work on this input.
anc = [0] * n — anc = [0, 0, 0] (bit u set: u is a prerequisite)
queue = deque(u for u in range(n) if indeg[u] == 0) — calls <genexpr>()
queue = deque(u for u in range(n) if indeg[u] == 0) — u = 0
queue = deque(u for u in range(n) if indeg[u] == 0) — yields 1; u = 1
queue = deque(u for u in range(n) if indeg[u] == 0) — u = 2
queue = deque(u for u in range(n) if indeg[u] == 0) — yields None
u = queue.popleft() — 1 taken from the front of queue; u = 1
u = queue.popleft() — 2 taken from the front of queue; u = 2
u = queue.popleft() — 0 taken from the front of queue; u = 0
return [bool(anc[v] >> u & 1) for u, v in queries] — u = 1
return [bool(anc[v] >> u & 1) for u, v in queries] — v = 2
return [bool(anc[v] >> u & 1) for u, v in queries] — returns [T, T]; u = 0; v = 0. Result: [T, T]
